Running a network on the exhaustive engine and checking it is done in `FitnessEvaluator`, `PartEvolution.Verifier` and `BoundedCheck`; "solved" means 0.985, 1, `Fitness == 1` or 0.95 depending on the file; `Verifier.Verify`, `BoundedCheck.Admit` and `Promotion.Promote` return null and log why; and a `Counterexample` is text, so no search can be given one.
We want a `Verifier` with one exhaustive check, a typed `Verdict` (passed, failed with a counterexample, unknown with the reason), and counterexamples that carry the inputs as a case.

Its responsibilities are:
* The verifier: training check and bounded check, sharing the engine setup and `Repetitions`
* `Verdict` and `Counterexample` (inputs, expected, read, and the step), with text rendering in its own file outside the proof loop
* `BoundedCheck.cs` split into the proof loop, input enumeration and rendering
* One definition of solved per kind of score, named, in place of four thresholds
* `Admit`, `Promote` and the part verifier returning verdicts rather than null
* `ProvenBound.Stopped` as a typed reason

The counterexample should hold a `ContractCase`, because CEGIS and the spec verifier add it to the cases a search scores on.
The thresholds should keep their current values where they differ for a reason, named for that reason, because changing one would change results.

Where: `SNP_Evolution/Evolution/Contracts/BoundedCheck.cs`, `PartEvolution.cs`, `Robustness.cs`, `SNP_Evolution/Evolution/FitnessEvaluator.cs`, `SNP_Evolution/Evolution/CheckDiagnosis.cs`, `SNP_Evolution/Evolution/Modules/Promotion.cs`, `SNP_Evolution/Cli/VerifyCommand.cs`, `SNP_Evolution/Storage/PartLibraryFiles.cs`.

Done when:
- [ ] One code path runs a network exhaustively against a contract, used by fitness confirmation, the part verifier and the bounded check
- [ ] No verification method returns null or bool for a verdict
- [ ] Golden runs unchanged (the `verify` output may change only in wording, stated in the pull request); `dotnet test` green

Read first: RESEARCH.md "Proving contracts", "Toward general synthesis" item 4
